guards: The only case in which the cross-encoder decides which chunk the answer leads with. Both halves rank a keyword-dense distractor above the chunk that answers the question, so the RRF-fused order leads with the wrong chunk; only the rerank step puts the right one first. Remove the IReranker call, swallow its result, or let the fused order stand and the top retrieved chunk becomes the distractor - which membership alone cannot see, because the relevant chunk is still in the set. The composer leads with the wrong recommendation and every citation still resolves.

evidence.intent: Sparse and dense both rank the DOAC-renal distractor first; RRF fuses to [distractor, rate-control, statin] and the reranker promotes the rate-control chunk. Asserts the retrieved list *starts* with the rate-control chunk, not merely that it is present.
evidence.question: Testpatient Sierra has permanent atrial fibrillation on apixaban - what resting heart rate should rate control be aiming for?

corpus.section: Resting rate target in permanent atrial fibrillation
corpus.text: In permanent atrial fibrillation a lenient resting rate target of under 110 beats per minute is reasonable initially, tightening only if symptoms or ventricular function demand it.
Direct oral anticoagulants require dose reduction or avoidance in renal impairment. Assess creatinine clearance before starting a DOAC in atrial fibrillation and periodically thereafter.
High-intensity statin therapy is recommended for patients with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease to lower LDL cholesterol.
